partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Pathway-corroborated inhibition without black-box warning
results.hypothesis: Pathway-corroborated target inhibition is more useful for treatment prediction when the candidate drug lacks a ChEMBL black-box warning.
results.body: R404 excluding drugs with a populated ChEMBL black-box-warning flag
results.mechanism_rationale: The biological mechanism is unchanged from R404; the drug-level safety property is independent negative evidence intended to remove high-risk candidates.
results.trapi_notes: The positive biological motif is TRAPI-expressible; the node-property exclusion, source constraints, disease-relative rank, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (process:Pathway)-[path_evidence:GENETIC_ASSOCIATION]->
      (object:Disease)
MATCH (target:Gene)-[membership:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (target)-[gene_evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (target)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
WHERE process.id STARTS WITH 'GO:'
  AND 'infores:geneticskp' IN
      coalesce(path_evidence.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:goa' IN coalesce(membership.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND gene_evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(binding.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )

  AND subject.chembl_black_box_warning IS NULL
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Pathway-corroborated black-box-warning diagnostic
results.hypothesis: The black-box-warning subset of R404 should have lower treatment enrichment or more contraindications if the ChEMBL safety property is useful negative evidence.
results.body: R404 restricted to drugs with ChEMBL black-box warning
results.mechanism_rationale: This is a matched negative-evidence diagnostic rather than an independent treatment mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: Same graph-path constraints as R439, with a positive node-property requirement.
results.cypher:
MATCH (process:Pathway)-[path_evidence:GENETIC_ASSOCIATION]->
      (object:Disease)
MATCH (target:Gene)-[membership:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (target)-[gene_evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (target)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
WHERE process.id STARTS WITH 'GO:'
  AND 'infores:geneticskp' IN
      coalesce(path_evidence.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:goa' IN coalesce(membership.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND gene_evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(binding.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )
  AND none(
    source IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
    WHERE source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
  )

  AND subject.chembl_black_box_warning = 'True'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
